name: diet-webapp

dependencies.name: diet-api
dependencies.description: Calls the Diet Manager API for all goals, plans, logs, recipes, weight, coach and ordering data.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs Dieters and Coaches in via SSO.

description: The single-page app both Dieters and Coaches use: Dieters set goals, plan meals from the recipe catalog, log food, track weight, and order lunch through Uber Eats; Coaches view their connected Dieters' plans and progress and leave feedback. It renders UI only and never calls Uber Eats, WhatsApp, or the nutrition database directly — all of that goes through diet-api.
